name: irc2.dev
server_info: DevNet IRC for developers and IT staff

channels.name: #lobby
channels.topic: Welcome to DevNet. Introductions and where to ask. Mention guide.

channels.name: #announcements
channels.topic: Staff announcements. Moderated: only operators and voiced users speak.

channels.name: #helpdesk
channels.topic: IT support: access, devices, mail, VPN. Mention helpdesk. Do not paste passwords or tokens.

channels.name: #dev
channels.topic: Software design, debugging, and implementation. Mention coder.

channels.name: #review
channels.topic: Code review. Mention reviewer. Recent lines are sent to the model when reviewer answers.

channels.name: #ops
channels.topic: Deploys, changes, and reliability. Mention oncall. Recent lines are sent to the model when oncall answers. No secrets.

channels.name: #incident
channels.topic: Active incidents. Mention oncall. Recent lines are sent to the model when oncall answers. Keep secrets out.

channels.name: #infra
channels.topic: Hosts, containers, storage, and platform. Mention sysadm.

channels.name: #net
channels.topic: DNS, routing, firewalls, and TLS. Mention netops.

channels.name: #security
channels.topic: Defensive security and reviews. Mention secop. Do not paste secrets or exploit material.

channels.name: #data
channels.topic: Schemas, queries, migrations, and backups. Mention dbadmin. Do not paste production data.

channels.name: #docs
channels.topic: Runbooks, decision notes, and status updates. Mention scribe. Recent lines are sent to the model when scribe answers.
